subject: physics

hotspots.label: Book on Table
hotspots.description: The book the surface supports — held up because the surface pushes back with an equal perpendicular force.
hotspots.colorHint: A neat hardcover book resting on the tabletop.
hotspots.function: Serves as the object the normal force supports.

hotspots.label: Normal Force Arrow
hotspots.description: The upward perpendicular push from the surface — always at a right angle to the tabletop.
hotspots.colorHint: A blue arrow rising from the table surface.
hotspots.function: Draws the surface's perpendicular support force.

hotspots.label: Weight Arrow
hotspots.description: The downward gravity pull on the book — the arrow the normal force matches on flat ground.
hotspots.colorHint: A downward amber arrow from the book's center.
hotspots.function: Shows the weight the normal force balances.

hotspots.label: Press Control
hotspots.description: Adds an extra downward press so the surface has to push back harder — the normal arrow grows.
hotspots.colorHint: A small hand-press pedestal on the table edge.
hotspots.function: Increases the required support and grows the normal force.

hotspots.label: Ramp Tilt
hotspots.description: Tilt the table into a ramp: the arrow stays perpendicular to the surface while shrinking, because only part of the weight presses in.
hotspots.colorHint: A tilt handle at the table's far end.
hotspots.function: Tilts the surface to show the normal force rotate and shrink.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper background, soft vignette, no floor grid. A tidy wooden table with a hardcover book, a blue perpendicular arrow and a downward amber arrow, plus a press pedestal and tilt handle. Saturated color on the arrows and dots only. Neutral studio light, no bloom, no emissive.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0. Tabletop: warm oak (roughness ~0.5). Book: amber cover. Normal arrow: matte blue prism with cone head. Weight arrow: coral. Pedestal and handle warm-grey. Readouts runtime overlay.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: the normal force as a surface's perpendicular support, equal to weight on flat ground and shrinking on ramps.

GEOMETRY: table (top ~2.4×1.2 at y=0.55) with a book (0.45×0.09×0.7) centered. Normal arrow up from top at book center; weight arrow down from the book center. Press pedestal (1.2,0.6,0.3) and tilt handle (-1.2,0.4,0.2) at the table ends.

INTERACTION: press button grows the arrows; tilt handle rotates the whole tabletop from 0° to 45° while the normal arrow stays perpendicular and shrinks (weight arrow constant). Elevator mode pops a small platform accelerating up to show the spike.

NAMED NODES: TableLegs, TableTop, Book, NormalArrow, WeightArrow, PressPedestal, TiltHandle, ElevatorPad. 6-10k tris.
